subject: Request: Zenith contract redlines — EU-only data residency + limited audit window and discount ask
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@zenithtx.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Jones <olivia.j@zenithtx.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenith redlines + ask on residency and pricing

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood, especially the private deployment options. We've reviewed the draft and attached our redlines (Zenith_Redlines_v3.docx). Two asks we need to resolve before legal will move to signature:

1) Data residency: all production data must remain in the EU (Ireland) region; no cross-border backups without prior written consent.
2) Audit access: we require periodic audit access for our internal compliance team and a third-party auditor once per 12 months. Access should be timeboxed (max 48 hours) and limited to logs and configuration only — no direct host access.

Commercial ask: Zenith is prepared to commit to a 36-month minimum committed spend and a 2x uplift in committed QPS if you can provide a one-time subscription credit (discount) of 20% on committed capacity in year 1 and a firm SLA addendum.

We appreciate Redwood’s flexibility to date. Please let us know what approvals you need internally and the earliest you can get back with a response.

Attachments: Zenith_Redlines_v3.docx (docx), SOW-Zenith-Prod-Appendix.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Sam
Director of IT Governance
Zenith Therapeutics

From: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Zenith redlines + ask on residency and pricing

Team — forwarding Zenith's redlines and asks. Short summary and my read:

- EU-only residency: feasible for Private (we have a Dublin availability zone). Need legal to confirm whether our standard backups/replication policy requires amendment or we can constrain via contractual language and config.
- Audit access: Zenith asks for once-per-12mo third-party audit, 48-hour timebox, logs/config only. This is non-standard but we often sign timeboxed, scoped audit windows; legal + security need to confirm scope.
- Pricing: 20% one-time credit on committed capacity in exchange for 36-month commit + 2x QPS. Deal desk wants an exec-approved concession for anything >15% or any multi-year credit slippage.

Requesting: 1) Laura — can you weigh in on whether we can accept the EU-only residency language with a replication exception for DR inside the same region? 2) Lauren/Marissa — deal desk: recommend max concession and approval route (VP sales or CRO OK?).

I propose we give Zenith a conditional commercial counter: 15% one-time credit + specific SLA addendum and a capped, auditable window for the third-party audit with an agreed scope of logs only. If legal confirms we can sign off on log-only audit and replication constraint, I can propose the counter to Sam.

Thanks,
Lukas
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the ping, Lukas. Quick read and legal guidance:

- EU-only residency: We can agree to 'data-at-rest' residency in the Ireland region for production and backups so long as we explicitly exclude cross-border replication. We'll add a clause: "Backups and replicas will be stored only within the Republic of Ireland region unless the parties agree in writing." Must confirm with infra that this is enforceable in the Private packaging.

- Audit access: We cannot provide host-level access. We will permit a timeboxed (maximum 48 hour) audit window for a named third-party auditor limited to (i) access to audit logs, (ii) configuration manifests, and (iii) redacted runbooks. We need an NDA amendment and an access plan; security must approve the procedures and a Redwood escort will be required. Also propose we add a cost-recovery clause: Auditor travel/ops or remote facilitation billed at our T&M rates beyond a standard remote window.

- Pricing/credits: Legal doesn't sign off on pricing but we can draft the requested residency/audit language. Any commercial concession above 15% requires VP or CRO approval per our discount matrix. For multi-year commitments, Finance prefers a revenue recognition and credit schedule (i.e., how the one-time credit is applied across months).

I can draft the residency/audit language for contract counsel to review. Please confirm who will own the finance/discount ask.

Laura Bennett
Lead Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Zenith redlines + ask on residency and pricing

Folks — thanks for the analysis. I talked with Finance and the CRO earlier today. Here's the approved concession we can offer to close the Zenith deal quickly:

1) Commercial: one-time subscription credit of 15% applied against the first 12 months of committed capacity (applies only if Zenith signs the 36-month commitment schedule and agrees to 2x committed QPS). This is the maximum retail concession without CRO escalation.

2) Data residency: we will accept EU-only (Ireland) residency for production data and backups as Laura outlined. Contract language will include the "no cross-border replication without written consent" clause.

3) Audit: single third-party audit per 12 months, 48-hour window, logs/configuration manifests and redacted runbooks only. Redwood escort required. Auditor must be pre-approved; any on-site work or special tooling beyond standard log export will be charged at T&M. We will add an NDA amendment and an access plan to the SOW.

4) SLA: include the requested SLA addendum with standard remedies; no additional financial penalty beyond standard SLA credit schedule.

Next steps: Lukas — please present the counter to Sam along these exact terms. Laura — please draft the residency and audit clauses and the NDA amendment so legal can attach to the SOW. Lauren — I'll loop CRO if Zenith pushes for >15% or asks to amortize the credit differently.

Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
